|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 1 June 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on Obi-Wan. Adds 1 to defense value and may not be excluded from battle. May lose this ard to cancel one weapon, duel, or lightsaber combat destiny draw here during opponent's turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Obi-Wan's Cape (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 2: Our Most Desperate Hour, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on Obi-Wan. Obi-Wan is defense value +1 and may not be excluded from battle. During opponent’s turn, may place this Effect in Lost Pile to cancel a just drawn duel, lightsaber combat, or weapon destiny draw here.” '''What changed:''' “Adds 1 to” → “Obi-Wan is”; added “+1”; “May lose” → “During opponent’s turn, may place”; “ard” → “Effect in Lost Pile”; “one weapon,” → “a just drawn”; added “lightsaber combat,”; “lightsaber combat” → “weapon”; “here during opponent's turn.” → “here.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards2.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards2.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #2 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 1 June 2002; first release date unknown); page 2, slip 16. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Obi-Wan's Cape]].
* Later text: [[Obi-Wan's Cape (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
|hatnote=Other versions of this Virtual Original card: [[Obi-Wan's Cape (V) (Virtual Set 2) (Errata)]]. For the Decipher card this slip modifies, see [[Obi-Wan's Cape]].
